description: This source file provides utility methods for AWS SDK, specifically for DynamoDB-related operations like region endpoint retrieval and key validation.

classes.name: AWSUtils
classes.description: Contains static utility methods for AWS SDK operations such as region endpoint retrieval and DynamoDB key validation.

methods.name: GetRegionEndpoint
methods.description: Returns a RegionEndpoint object based on the given AWS zone string, defaults to USWest2.

methods.name: ValidateDynamoDBPartitionKey
methods.description: Validates that a DynamoDB partition key length does not exceed 2048 characters.

methods.name: ValidateDynamoDBRowKey
methods.description: Validates that a DynamoDB row key length does not exceed 1024 characters.
